task: [config/model_providers.json] GitHub Actions iş akışlarındaki 160.3 saatlik gecikme ve darboğazı ortadan kaldırmak için `config/model_providers.json` yapılandırmasındaki fallback zincirinden 'cerebras' sağlayıcısını geçerli API anahtarları tanımlanana kadar geçici olarak çıkarın veya zincir yürütücüsünü eksik anahtar (`no_key`) tespit edildiğinde zaman aşımını beklemeden anında bir sonraki aktif sağlayıcıya geçecek şekilde güncelleyin.

evidence.description: Configuration file containing model provider definitions and fallback chain order where 'cerebras' is listed without valid API keys ('no_key').

factual_findings: The fallback chain configured in config/model_providers.json includes the 'cerebras' provider.
Because 'cerebras' lacks valid API keys ('no_key'), requests to it encounter timeout delays, accumulating to a total of 160.3 hours of bottlenecking in GitHub Actions workflows.
Bypassing providers with 'no_key' status or removing 'cerebras' from config/model_providers.json eliminates unnecessary timeout wait times in CI workflows.
hypotheses: Temporarily removing 'cerebras' from the fallback array in config/model_providers.json will instantly prevent GitHub Actions from attempting calls to 'cerebras', eliminating the 160.3-hour delay.
Updating the chain execution logic to fast-fail when 'no_key' is detected will make the fallback mechanism resilient against unconfigured providers in the future.
result.recommendation: Update config/model_providers.json to temporarily exclude 'cerebras' from the active fallback chain until valid API credentials are provided, and/or update the executor to immediately advance to the next provider upon detecting 'no_key'.
result.next_action: Modify config/model_providers.json to remove 'cerebras' from the active fallback list and verify CI workflow execution speed.
